real-world clinical practice data from the Flatiron Health database of 625 patients with mCRPC treated with radium- 223 between 2013 and 2017, primarily in a community practice setting in the US. The Flatiron Health database comprises a large sample of patients with wide geographical

coverage within the US, providing a representative sample of patients with mCRPC in clinical practice. Consequently, this database provides a robust source of information about treatment patterns and outcomes in the community setting in the US.
